user_story: As a user, I want to add and remove elements on the 'Add/Remove Elements' page so that I can dynamically manage my list of elements. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click the 'Add Element' button, a new element is added to the page. 2. The URL remains the same after adding an element. 3. I can remove an added element, and it should disappear from the page. 4. The 'flash-messages' div (id: 'flash-messages') should be present at all times.
